title: DINOv2-B/L dual-capacity kernel selection screen

features.input: deterministic direct resize 392x392 with ImageNet normalization

reference.classifier: sklearn SVC C=3 kernel=rbf gamma=scale using SVC.predict

dcks.kernel_gamma: independent sklearn gamma=scale equivalent computed from each inner/outer training matrix
dcks.selection: within every outer fold, select mode by four-fold inner OOF balanced accuracy using only outer-training rows
dcks.tie_breaking: higher inner BA, then lower complexity in order L_ONLY, B_ONLY, ADD_L050, GEO_L050, ADD_L075, ADD_L025, GEO_L075, GEO_L025

screen_gate.on_success: freeze PAT-J-260729-002 and extract/evaluate untouched train-only episodes 2 and 3
screen_gate.on_fail: stop capacity grid; do not add backbones or tune kernel bank

reporting: B_RBF, L_RBF, and DCKS balanced accuracy
DCKS gain versus both B and L
class-level positive/negative deltas and worst class
